findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "find_package" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Searches the catalog of tracked packages and AI models by case-insensitive name prefix and returns up to 15 matches ordered by popularity, each with its ecosyst…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: package_status, symbol_status, recent_changes · Private data: model_status, eol_status · Public sink: package_status, list_versions · Destructive: model_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: package_status, symbol_status, recent_changes · Private data: model_status, eol_status · Public sink: package_status, list_versions · Destructive: model_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
